note: Generated by `npm run api:catalog` from src/server/commands/registry.ts. Do not edit. POST /api/commands/<name> with the input as JSON; responses are { data } or { error: { code, message, details } }.

commands.name: account.delete
commands.summary: Permanently delete your account and your juniors’ data.

commands.name: account.get
commands.summary: Get your account details and notification preferences.

commands.name: account.me
commands.summary: Get the signed-in account (user, own player profile, provider profile).

commands.name: account.update
commands.summary: Update your name or notification preferences.

commands.name: admin.reviewSafety
commands.summary: Approve or reject a provider’s safety check.

commands.name: admin.safetyQueue
commands.summary: Safety checks waiting for review.

commands.name: assistant.history
commands.summary: The current assistant conversation.

commands.name: assistant.reset
commands.summary: Start a new assistant conversation.

commands.name: assistant.resolve
commands.summary: Confirm or cancel the changes the assistant proposed.

commands.name: assistant.send
commands.summary: Ask the assistant to look something up or make changes (changes need confirmation).

commands.name: bookings.acceptInvite
commands.summary: Accept a coach’s invitation (optionally every invite in that series). Uses a credit or saved card when available; otherwise returns a payment link.

commands.name: bookings.addPlayer
commands.summary: Add one of your students (or their junior) to a session — optionally every future session in the series (e.g. “book Maya Thursdays at 3”).

commands.name: bookings.approve
commands.summary: Approve a player’s request to join (outside the level range or unrated).

commands.name: bookings.attendance
commands.summary: Mark a player attended or no-show. Pay-after bookings are charged when marked attended; no-shows follow your policy unless you waive the fee.

commands.name: bookings.cancel
commands.summary: Cancel a booking. Players get refunds/credits per the cancellation policy; coaches removing a player always refund in full.

commands.name: bookings.checkout
commands.summary: Get the payment link that confirms a held or offered booking.

commands.name: bookings.create
commands.summary: Book a session for yourself or a junior you manage. Uses a package credit when available; returns a checkout link when payment is needed.

commands.name: bookings.decline
commands.summary: Decline a player’s request to join.

commands.name: bookings.declineInvite
commands.summary: Decline a coach’s invitation to a session.

commands.name: bookings.get
commands.summary: Get one booking with its session, payment state, and what cancelling would cost.

commands.name: bookings.markPaid
commands.summary: Record that a player paid you outside the app (cash, Venmo, Zelle).

commands.name: bookings.mine
commands.summary: Your bookings (and your juniors’): upcoming or past.

commands.name: bookings.waiveFee
commands.summary: Waive a late-cancel or no-show fee (or an unpaid balance) for a booking.

commands.name: clients.import
commands.summary: Save students you want to invite (name plus email or phone), as rows or as pasted text with one person per line. You send the invite from your own phone or email; they join your crew from your link.

text.description: Pasted lines like "Maya Chen, maya@example.com" or "Sam Lee, (415) 555-0100"

commands.name: clients.invites
commands.summary: People you’ve invited who haven’t joined your crew yet, with the invite text to send them.

commands.name: clients.join
commands.summary: Join a coach’s crew from their link (yourself, or a junior you manage).

commands.name: clients.leave
commands.summary: Leave a coach’s crew (stops their messages and invites).

commands.name: clients.list
commands.summary: Your students: contact, upcoming bookings, last session, and anything owed. Optional name search.

commands.name: clients.preview
commands.summary: Preview pasted contacts (one person per line) before saving them as invites: who is ready to add and which lines need an email or phone.

commands.name: clients.removeInvite
commands.summary: Remove a pending invite.

commands.name: clients.update
commands.summary: Add private notes about a student, or archive/restore them.

commands.name: coaches.mine
commands.summary: The coaches and hitters you (or your juniors) train with.

commands.name: courts.delete
commands.summary: Remove one of your courts.

commands.name: courts.list
commands.summary: List your regular courts.

commands.name: courts.save
commands.summary: Add or edit one of your courts (name, address, notes, booking link, booking window note).

commands.name: credits.mine
commands.summary: Your package credits with each coach.

commands.name: credits.sold
commands.summary: Packages your students bought and credits remaining.

commands.name: devices.register
commands.summary: Receive push notifications on this device (the native app sends its APNs token after you allow notifications).

commands.name: devices.unregister
commands.summary: Stop push notifications on this device (on sign-out).

commands.name: family.addJunior
commands.summary: Add a junior you are the parent or guardian of, with signed consent.

commands.name: family.list
commands.summary: List your player profile and the juniors you manage.

commands.name: family.removeJunior
commands.summary: Remove a junior you manage and delete their data.

commands.name: find.providers
commands.summary: Find coaches and paid hitting partners (optionally by type, area, or name), soonest availability first.

commands.name: find.sessions
commands.summary: Find open group clinics in the next two weeks (optionally by area or keyword).

commands.name: messages.read
commands.summary: Messages in one conversation (marks it read).

commands.name: messages.send
commands.summary: Send a message in a conversation.

commands.name: messages.start
commands.summary: Open a conversation: a coach with a student (playerId), a coach with everyone in a series (offeringId), or a player with a coach (providerId).

commands.name: messages.threads
commands.summary: Your conversations with unread counts.

commands.name: money.summary
commands.summary: Your money: collected, refunded, fees in the last N days (default 30), and who still owes you.

commands.name: notifications.list
commands.summary: Your recent notifications (newest first) and how many are unread.

commands.name: notifications.markRead
commands.summary: Mark all your notifications as read.

commands.name: offerings.archive
commands.summary: Stop a session series. Future sessions without bookings are removed.

commands.name: offerings.create
commands.summary: Create a clinic, private lesson, semi-private, or hitting session — one-off or weekly (choose weekdays), or open slots players book themselves.

commands.name: offerings.get
commands.summary: Get one of your session series.

commands.name: offerings.list
commands.summary: List your active session series.

commands.name: offerings.update
commands.summary: Change a session series (title, price, capacity, level, court, days or time). Applies to future sessions.

commands.name: onboarding.complete
commands.summary: Finish sign-up: confirm you are an adult and say whether you coach or hit.

commands.name: packages.buy
commands.summary: Get the checkout link to buy a package.

commands.name: packages.list
commands.summary: List your packages (prepaid credit bundles).

commands.name: packages.public
commands.summary: Packages a coach offers, by profile link.

commands.name: packages.save
commands.summary: Create or edit a package, e.g. “10 privates for $800, valid 6 months”.

commands.name: payments.mine
commands.summary: Your payments and receipts, and the card on file.

commands.name: payouts.connect
commands.summary: Get the link to set up (or finish setting up) payouts to your bank.

commands.name: payouts.refresh
commands.summary: Re-check whether your payout account can take payments.

commands.name: plan.get
commands.summary: Your current plan (Free with a per-payment fee, or Pro monthly with no fee) and the options.

commands.name: plan.manage
commands.summary: Get the link to manage or cancel your Pro subscription.

commands.name: plan.subscribe
commands.summary: Get the checkout link to switch to Pro.

commands.name: players.update
commands.summary: Update a player profile you manage (name, gender, ratings, UTR profile id).

commands.name: provider.public
commands.summary: Get a coach or hitter’s public profile by profile link.

commands.name: provider.settings
commands.summary: Get your coaching/hitting business settings: rates, policies, payouts, plan.

commands.name: provider.setup
commands.summary: Start (or change) offering coaching and/or paid hitting.

commands.name: provider.update
commands.summary: Update your business settings: rates, cancellation window, late-cancel and no-show fees, bio, profile link.

commands.name: safety.submit
commands.summary: Submit your USTA Safe Play ID or background-check reference to unlock sessions for juniors.

commands.name: schedule.public
commands.summary: Get a coach or hitter’s public page with upcoming bookable sessions.

commands.name: sessions.cancel
commands.summary: Cancel one session (rain, illness): everyone booked is notified and refunded in full or has their credit returned.

commands.name: sessions.cancelDay
commands.summary: Rain-out: cancel all of your sessions on a date (YYYY-MM-DD, your time zone), notifying and refunding everyone.

commands.name: sessions.get
commands.summary: Get one of your sessions.

commands.name: sessions.list
commands.summary: List your sessions (default: the next 14 days; or give days/offsetDays, or ISO from/to) with seats taken, waitlist, and requests.

commands.name: sessions.roster
commands.summary: Who is booked, waitlisted, or requesting for one of your sessions, with payment status and contact.

commands.name: sessions.update
commands.summary: Edit one session: move it (booked players are told), change duration/capacity/price, add a note, or record the court booking.

commands.name: sessions.view
commands.summary: A session’s public details, plus (when signed in) who you can book and any booking you already have.
